title.zh: 化石燃料之争使COP31气候谈判陷入僵局
title.en: Fight over fossil fuels leaves COP31 climate talks in deadlock

summary.en: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge claims to have proved the Riemann hypothesis with help from Claude, a problem that has eluded top mathematicians for decades. If verified, it would be another major AI achievement in mathematics.

title.zh: 运行诡异加速的太空岩石仍令天文学家困惑
title.en: Weirdly accelerating space rock keeps puzzling astronomers

summary.zh: 名为1998 KY26的“暗彗星”运动方式异常，科学家尚未完全理解其加速原因。日本探测器原计划2031年造访，但因发动机故障无法成行，相关谜团可能继续悬而未决。该事件牵涉小天体动力学、行星防御和深空任务风险，值得深入阅读。
summary.en: The dark comet 1998 KY26 is moving in a way that scientists do not fully understand. A Japanese probe was due to visit it in 2031, but engine trouble will prevent the encounter, leaving the mystery unresolved. It is worth reading because it highlights unexplained small-body dynamics and the fragility of deep-space missions.

title.zh: 《Checks and Balance》通讯：2028年竞选阵营拥挤
title.en: Checks and Balance newsletter: The crowded field for 2028

summary.en: The Checks and Balance newsletter examines the crowded field of hopefuls for the 2028 U.S. presidential race. U.S. editor Charlotte Howard looks at how candidates are trying to stand out. It is worth reading for early signals about party strategies, fundraising and the issues likely to shape the campaign.

title.zh: 真正的科技成瘾者
title.en: The real tech addicts

summary.zh: 文章探讨为什么有些人会陷入数字“兔子洞”，成为真正的科技成瘾者。它不止停留在屏幕使用时长警告，而是分析可能导致强迫性使用的心理与社会因素。理解数字依赖的成因和代价，有助于读者反思自身与科技的关系。
summary.en: This article explores why some people fall down digital rabbit holes and become genuinely tech-addicted. It looks beyond simple screen-time warnings to the psychological and social factors that may drive compulsive use. It is worth reading for a clearer understanding of digital dependence and its personal costs.

title.zh: 其他行星闻起来是什么味道？答案藏在化学中
title.en: What do other planets smell like? The answer hides in their chemistry

summary.zh: 我们或许永远无法直接闻到其他行星的气味，但其化学组成可以提供线索。文章解释大气与表面化学如何决定一颗行星“可能闻起来”是什么样。它把行星科学与感官想象结合起来，适合想轻松理解系外行星大气的读者。
summary.en: We will probably never smell other planets directly, but their chemistry can offer clues about what their atmospheres might be like. The article explains how chemical composition could shape a planet’s hypothetical scent. It is worth reading as an accessible blend of planetary science and imagination.
